_note: Sail clearance check for the 128 m concept: one main deck with a house, one deck above it with the bridge forward. Every sail and mast value is a placeholder until a sail plan exists. Mast stations are the 68 m longitudinal-section fractions (mizzen 21.0/68, main 39.9/68) scaled to 128 m. Houses are envelopes to be laid out, not room plans. Heights are metres above the waterline, using the deck floors from build-elevations.mjs (Main 3.35 m). Run with: npm run validate:sails
